7:196.text: Indeed, my protector is Allāh, who has sent down the Book; and He is an ally to the righteous.

7:197.text: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves."

7:198.text: And if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see.

7:199.text: enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.

7:200.text: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.

7:201.text: Indeed, those who fear Allāh - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember
and at once they have insight.

7:202.text: increase them in error; then they do not stop short.

7:203.text: , do not bring them a sign
, they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This
is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe."

7:204.text: So when the Qur’ān is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.

7:205.text: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.

7:206.text: Indeed, those who are near your Lord
are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate.
